editorial.blurb: A standout all-you-can-eat sushi spot in the South Loop with high-quality fish and competitive prices that keeps locals coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Stick with the rolls over nigiri (rice-to-fish ratio is better), try the dinner AYCE for Hamachi Kama, and watch portion sizes to avoid the $1 per-piece waste charge—aim to finish what you order.
